Tool: get_template
Description: Retrieves a retrosynthetic template and other information by its ID.
Arguments:

Tool: apply_template
Description: Applies a retrosynthetic template to a molecule. If one template is applicable to different groups, all possible outcomes are returned.
Arguments:
- molecule_smiles (str, required): SMILES string of the target molecule.
- template_id (str, required): Identifier of the retrosynthetic template to apply.

Tool: verify_step
Description: Verifies if a retrosynthetic step is valid. This tool might fail for intramolecular reactions.
Arguments:
- molecule_smiles (str, required): SMILES string of the target molecule.
- template_id (str, required): Retrosynthetic template in SMARTS format.
- precursors (list[str], required): List of SMILES strings representing the precursor molecules.

Tool: search_template_catalog_by_criteria
Description: Searches the retrosynthetic template database based on specified criteria. The search criteria refer to the forward reaction.
Arguments:
- molecule_smiles (str, required): SMILES string of the target molecule.
- functional_groups_broken (list[str] | None, optional, default: None): List of functional groups that are broken when the template is applied in the forward reaction. None will result in not filtering with this criterion.
- functional_groups_formed (list[str] | None, optional, default: None): List of functional groups that are formed when the template is applied in the forward reaction. None will result in not filtering with this criterion.
- bonds_formed (list[str] | None, optional, default: None): List of bonds that are formed in the forward reaction (e.g., "6-6", "6-8"). None will result in not filtering with this criterion.
- bonds_broken (list[str] | None, optional, default: None): List of bonds that are broken in the forward reaction (e.g., "6-6", "6-8"). None will result in not filtering with this criterion.
- bonds_order_changed (list[str] | None, optional, default: None): List of bonds whose order is changed in the forward reaction (e.g., "6-6 (1.0->2.0)"). None will result in not filtering with this criterion.
- limit (int, optional, default: 10): Maximum number of templates to return. Default is 10.

Description: Searches a catalog for available precursors.
Arguments:

- limit (int, optional, default: 5): Maximum number of results to return. Default is 5.

Tool: is_buyable

Arguments:

Tool: deprotect_molecule
Description: Removes protecting groups from a molecule represented by a SMILES string.
Arguments:
- molecule_smiles (str, required): SMILES string of the molecule with protecting groups.

Tool: detect_protection_groups
Description: Detects protecting groups in a molecule and their positions.
Arguments:
- smiles (str, required): SMILES string of the molecule to analyze.

Tool: detect_functional_groups
Description: Detects functional groups in a molecule represented by a SMILES string.
Arguments:
- smiles (str, required): SMILES string of the molecule to analyze.

Tool: map_reaction_smiles
Description: Maps atoms in a reaction SMILES string using attention-guided atom mapping. Sometimes, the mapping may help to get the templates to work.
Arguments:
- reaction_smiles (str, required): Reaction SMILES string to be mapped.

Tool: smiles_to_cas
Description: Converts a SMILES string to a CAS number.
Arguments:
- molecule_smiles (str, required): SMILES string of the molecule to convert.

Tool: cas_to_smiles
Description: Converts a CAS number to an isomeric SMILES string.
Arguments:
- cas_number (str, required): CAS number of the molecule to convert.

Tool: check_smiles_reaction_template_matching
Description: Checks if the SMARTS of a reaction template matches any substructure in the given SMILES.
Arguments:
- smiles (str, required): SMILES string of the molecule to check.
- template_id (str, required): ID of the reaction template to check.
